content_sections.heading: About NFSU Guwahati Campus
content_sections.text: National Forensic Sciences University is an Institution of National Importance under the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India. Its Guwahati Campus is at Narakasur Hilltop, Near TV Tower, GMC Road, Bhangagarh Guwahati, Assam - 781032. The Campus Director signed this recruitment notice. The Site Civil Engineer will manage on-site construction work at Molong, Kamrup.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: NFSU Guwahati Campus accepts applications for the Site Civil Engineer post only by email. The notice does not prescribe an application form or an email subject line. Prepare your updated Curriculum Vitae (CV). Attach your academic documents and your professional experience documents. Email the CV and documents to [email protected] . Make sure the email reaches the university before 6 PM (1800 Hours) on 30 November 2026. CVs received after this time will not be considered and will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice is for the post of Site Civil Engineer on a contractual basis. It does not print the number of posts. B.Tech. in Civil Engineering from a Govt recognised Institution. The "Required Skills and Qualifications" part of the job description lists: Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, or a related field. Minimum 05 years' experience as a site engineer/supervisor in a large project, particularly one that is institutional or residential in nature, with the Govt or a reputed private company. The job description also states: minimum 5 years of site experience in civil construction (institutional or educational campus). Retired engineers from Govt. Agencies (e.g., PWD, CPWD etc) are also eligible. Proficient in contemporary construction technology, including the technological tools and software/automation solutions used by present-day Architects/Engineers. A thorough basic understanding of construction engineering, institutional buildings, landscape architecture, and basic electrical, MEP and HVAC issues. Proficient in understanding various drawings and well versed with the basic aspects of civil structural engineering. Deep understanding of construction methods, materials, soil mechanics and structural design. Software proficiency: AutoCAD, Civil 3D, and MS Project/Office Suite. Leadership: strong team leadership and the ability to manage contractors, subcontractors and labourers. Communication: excellent written and verbal communication skills for liaising with stakeholders. Must be able to work on-site in various weather conditions. Regularly required to walk, stand and inspect construction sites. The upper age limit for the NFSU Site Civil Engineer post is 70 years. The notice gives no minimum age, no cut-off date for age and no age relaxation. The notice states that a competitive remuneration package will be offered, negotiable based on qualification and experience. It does not print a pay amount or any allowances. For the full wording of the eligibility conditions for this post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: NFSU Site Civil Engineer Job Description
content_sections.text: The job type is contractual and the location is Molong, Kamrup. According to the notice, the Site Civil Engineer will manage onsite construction activities. The engineer must ensure that projects are completed on time, within budget and as per design specifications. The role acts as the primary technical bridge between the client, CPWD, the design team and the on-site construction team, and ensures that all work meets safety, quality and regulatory standards. The notice lists these key responsibilities: Site Supervision: Oversee day-to-day construction activities to ensure adherence to architectural drawings, structural blueprints and specifications. Technical Guidance: Set out sites, manage levelling, and provide technical advice to the contractor team and workers to avoid discrepancies. Quality Control: Inspect construction materials and workmanship regularly to ensure compliance with quality standards (ISO/BIS/local codes), and reject substandard work. Safety Compliance: Enforce health and safety protocols (OSHA/local regulations), ensuring all personnel wear PPE and hazards are minimized. Progress Monitoring and Reporting: Submit daily/weekly progress updates, track project milestones and identify potential bottlenecks. Resource Management: Track raw material usage, ensure material availability, and optimize labour and equipment allocation to avoid delays. Problem-Solving: Resolve on-site technical difficulties, design clashes or unexpected site conditions promptly. Stakeholder Liaison: Coordinate with project managers, clients, architects and local authorities to ensure smooth project execution.
